remarks:
Welcome to 33 Pennsylvania Avenue, where classic charm meets everyday convenience in the heart of the Village of Lakewood. Whether you're searching for a year-round residence or the perfect home base to enjoy summer days on Chautauqua Lake, this property offers a versatile layout in an unbeatable location.

Step inside to a spacious living room that flows into a formal dining room, creating an inviting space for entertaining family and friends. The large eat-in kitchen features stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and plenty of room for casual dining. Just off the kitchen, you'll find a practical mudroom with access from the blacktop driveway, making it the perfect everyday entry. The first floor also offers a full bathroom and a convenient laundry room complete with a slop sink.

Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms and a full guest bathroom. The primary bedroom features its own private ensuite bath, providing a relaxing retreat at the end of the day.

Outside, enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening on the covered front porch. The detached two-car garage offers excellent storage and parking, while the blacktop driveway provides additional off-street parking for guests.

Located just minutes from Chautauqua Lake, parks, restaurants, shopping, and all the amenities Lakewood has to offer, this home combines comfort, functionality, and an ideal location. Whether you're looking for your next full-time home or a convenient getaway to enjoy the best of lake life, 33 Pennsylvania Avenue is ready to welcome you home.
